question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is: **populist**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"populist"** refers to a political approach that strives to appeal to ordinary people who feel that their concerns are disregarded by established elite groups. (जनप्रिय)

 
 
• **Example: **The candidate's populist policies earned him widespread support among the working class.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that despite certain difficulties, like the necessity to strike a balance between divergent interests and the threat of populist movements, democracy is still one of the most popular systems of governance in the world.
 
• Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate word to fill in blank no. 5 is **'populist'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **populist**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Marginal** (सीमांत): Something of secondary or minor importance.

 
 
• **Example:** The issue was considered marginal and did not receive much attention in the meeting.
 
 
 
• **Elitist** (अभिजात्य): Relating to or supporting the view that a society or system should be led by an elite.
 
 
• **Example: **The politician was criticized for his elitist views that favored the wealthy.
 
 
 
• **Negligible** (नगण्य): So small or unimportant as to be not worth considering; insignificant.
 
 
• **Example:** The cost of the item was negligible compared to its benefits.
